name: MonarchDataExportRequest
title: DataExportRequest
wrapsNative: MonarchCard with MonarchBadge, MonarchCheckboxGroup, MonarchSelect (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox), MonarchProgress (androidx.compose.material3.LinearProgressIndicator), MonarchInlineNotice and MonarchButton; dates with android.icu.text.DateFormat
summary: A Download your data card: the person picks what to include and the format, requests an export, follows its status in words and downloads the file until it expires.
whenToUse: In account or privacy settings, to let people request a copy of their data and download it once the product has built it.
whenNotToUse: For a report the app can produce at once, use MonarchDownloadReportButton. For deleting an account, use a confirmation such as MonarchTypeToConfirmInput.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchDataExportRequest(status: MonarchDataExportStatus, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, requestedAt: Long? = null, readyAt: Long? = null, expiresAt: Long? = null, scope: List<MonarchDataExportScopeOption> = emptyList(), formats: List<MonarchDataExportFormatOption> = emptyList(), defaultFormat: String? = null, preparationNote: String? = null, failureReason: String? = null, pending: Boolean? = null, onRequest: (suspend (MonarchDataExportRequestDetails) -> Unit)? = null, onDownload: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchDataExportRequestLabels = MonarchDataExportRequestLabels())
enum class MonarchDataExportStatus { Idle, Requested, Preparing, Ready, Expired, Failed }
class MonarchDataExportScopeOption(id: String, label: String, description: String? = null)
data class MonarchDataExportRequestDetails(scope: List<String>, format: String?)

class MonarchDataExportRequestLabels(title: String? = null, description: String? = null, status: ((MonarchDataExportStatus) -> String)? = null, request: String? = null, requestAgain: String? = null, download: String? = null, scopeLegend: String? = null, scopeRequired: String? = null, formatLabel: String? = null, requested: ((date: String?) -> String)? = null, preparing: ((date: String?) -> String)? = null, preparingProgress: String? = null, ready: ((readyAt: String?, expiresAt: String?) -> String)? = null, expired: ((expiresAt: String?) -> String)? = null, failed: String? = null, requestFailed: String? = null, date: ((millis: Long) -> String)? = null)

options.name: status
options.description: Where the export is, as the product reports it.

options.name: requestedAt, readyAt, expiresAt
options.description: Epoch milliseconds (UTC) used in the status line.

options.name: scope
options.description: Kinds of data to include; all are ticked at first and at least one must stay ticked.

options.name: formats
options.description: File formats offered in a menu.

options.name: defaultFormat
options.description: The format chosen at first; null or an unknown value chooses the first format.

options.name: preparationNote
options.description: How long preparing takes; shown before requesting and while requested or preparing.

options.name: failureReason
options.description: More detail shown when the status is Failed.

options.name: pending
options.description: The busy state of the request button for apps that track it; null shows it busy while onRequest runs.

options.name: onRequest
options.description: Requests an export; throw to show the failure. Without it no form is shown.

options.name: onDownload
options.description: Downloads the file while Ready. Without it no download button is shown.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string and the date format.

states.name: idle
states.description: Not requested badge, the scope, the format and Request export.

states.name: requested
states.description: Info Requested badge and "We received your request on …".

states.name: preparing
states.description: Info Preparing badge, the status line and an indeterminate progress bar named Preparing your export.

states.name: ready
states.description: Success Ready badge, the ready and expiry dates and a primary Download button.

states.name: expired
states.description: Neutral Expired badge, the expiry line and Request a new export.

states.name: failed
states.description: Danger Failed badge, the failure line and reason, and Request a new export.

states.name: sending
states.description: The request button shows its progress indicator and the scope and format are disabled.

states.name: request failed
states.description: A danger MonarchInlineNotice with the exception's message or "The request did not go through. Try again.".

states.name: scope missing
states.description: With nothing ticked, the checklist shows "Choose at least one kind of data." and nothing is sent.

appearance: A MonarchCard with the title as a subheading beside a status MonarchBadge in the neutral, info, success or danger tone, the description and preparation note in muted text, the status line in default text and primary buttons. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web renders the download as a link with an href; Android has no download link, so the app downloads in onDownload (for example with DownloadManager). onRequest is a suspend function that throws instead of a promise that rejects, and the web's errorMessage is replaced by the exception's message. Dates are epoch milliseconds formatted with android.icu.text.DateFormat (medium date, short time) in the device locale and time zone, or by labels.date; the web's locale, timeZone and dateFormat props are not offered. The web's headingLevel has no Android equivalent: the title is a heading. The request runs in the card's coroutine scope, so the app may move the status on while it runs. There is no iOS DataExportRequest yet. Experimental: a product composite that waits for a Rook app to adopt it.
accessibility: The title is a heading and the card is a traversal group.
The status is a word in the badge, never color alone.
The status line and failure reason are one always-present polite live region, so each status change is announced.
The progress indicator while preparing is named Preparing your export.
The scope is a MonarchCheckboxGroup with its label; the missing-scope error is its error text.
A failed request is an assertive MonarchInlineNotice, because it blocks the person.
Buttons keep 48dp touch targets; text wraps at the largest font size.
edgeCases: Without onRequest no form is shown, for products that request exports elsewhere.
The scope and format choices are kept by the card (saved across configuration changes); scope ids no longer offered are dropped from the request.
A missing date leaves its clause out of the status line.
A request that throws CancellationException is not shown as a failure.
Ready without onDownload shows the status line only.
